noReuse.scope: New native no-reuse cases versus earlier frozen native-reuse and SDK cases; no contemporaneous controls. Native transaction SQL, algorithms, ping, transaction boundaries and driver defaults unchanged. No reusable statement handles; ordinary database/sql Conn query calls use MySQL per-call prepare/execute/close, confirmed by server counters. Timeout-boundary query and connection-check cancellations remain separate from steady-window validity; full runs are not error-free.

limitations: Single short invocation per tool/core budget; no confidence intervals.
60s warmup and 120s planned window; exact complete sample boundaries retained.
Local TCP only; no simulated latency.
CPU costs are client/database process CPU time, excluding separately charged host IRQ/kernel work and observers.
Expected rollback and all successful/failed workload work consume CPU; denominator is committed district-counter New-Orders.
Reusable statements are an end-to-end client-path advantage; native no-reuse provides closer transport comparison, not identical SDK internals.
Deadline errors remain classified separately; valid measurement is not a clean full run.
